source_row.rationale: Common asthma triggers may include allergens (such as pollen or dust mites), respiratory infections, exercise, and environmental irritants (such as smoke or strong odors), among other individually variable triggers, relevant for asthma clients across the age spectrum, requiring individualized trigger identification and avoidance strategies.
source_row.source_name: National Asthma Education and Prevention Program — Asthma Trigger Identification
